description: The chart illustrates a breakdown of three components—Context, Generated Response, and Other—for two methods labeled “Ours” and “Standard” using horizontal stacked bars. The category axis is vertical, listing the two categories “Ours” (top) and “Standard” (bottom) with no additional ordering cues beyond this display order. The value axis is horizontal and represents proportions as percentages on a linear scale; explicit tick marks are not shown, but each stacked bar spans a full 100% width and contains percentage labels within segments. For “Ours,” the stacked bar consists of a blue Context segment labeled 60.6%, followed by an orange Generated Response segment labeled 31.7%, and a green Other segment labeled 7.7%. For “Standard,” the stacked bar consists of a blue Context segment labeled 23.6%, followed by an orange Generated Response segment labeled 51.1%, and a green Other segment labeled 25.3%. A legend at the bottom maps blue to Context, orange to Generated Response, and green to Other, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the in-segment percentage labels.
